nom: ANUA Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil

avis.texte: Overall its amazing and i would but it again i just have to make sure i dont throw the cap away.

avis.titre: I don't really know what I'm looking for with this one.
avis.texte: Skin felt clean after using this and my face cleanser but no notable differences.
One of my favorite skincare products ever! Amazing on my 58 year old skin!

I have been using this cleansing oil every morning for a week now and have been loving it so far! My pores are smaller and overall clearer! I really struggled with black heads on my nose and in general my T zone and this has minimized them! I also did not break out when starting it like I usually do with using a new product.
makes my skin feel super soft and helps a lot with oil control

This is the best cleansing oil I've ever used. No matter how well or what I use to double cleanse, I still see my pores are not clear. I have dry skin & its the only cleansing oil that has cleared my pores.
I love, love, love this cleansing oil. My skin feels so much smoother and appears more hydrated since using it.

I have been using this product for about a month now and I have to say it really works for me. I have oily skin and I wear sunblock daily. It really emulsifies a lot of the oil and dirty my skin accumulates throughout the day. Perfect for a good foaming cleanser. I use the Heartleaf Quercetinol Pore Deep Cleansing Foam witha silicon brush head and my skin feels great afterwards. Clean and clear. I'm love it except if you have acne proned skin. I would use it.

avis.titre: I will buy this product again
avis.texte: This Anua Heartleaf pore control cleansing oil is part of a 2-step cleansing routine for my skin and it works really well. I have very sensitive skin which is due in part to Hormone Replacement therapy for post menopause. I find when I start with this oil based cleanser and after a thorough rinse my skin felt great, but the key is to follow it up with a gentle cleanser. Never skip that last step as you may find your skin responding with unwanted acne. I have been impressed with the appearance of my skin after daily use as my pores look almost nonexistent. So, the end result is that my skin looks firmer and more radiant.
This face was highly recommended as part of a double cleanse.

Let me start by saying that I love Anua products. I bought this oil after seeing so many rave reviews. I did patch test, and the first use was great. I noticed during the second time using that I had some mild discomfort and woke up that night to a painful rash all over my face and neck. I do not usually have issues with skincare, and can use the heartleaf toner without incident. Please, please avoid this. For reference my skin was fine prior, and this is the only new item. I am still trying to calm my skin down over three days later, and may have to call the derm it is so bad.
I started using this and it works great! This is only step one to cleaning ladies! You gotta use the cleanser right afterwards! Works great for dry skin!

avis.titre: This product made me break out
avis.texte: I brought thus product not seeing any reviews or anything just off a whim. After i got home i was like ooh i like this. Took all my make up off, i loved. A few days later i started breaking out. My face was already clear, so i thought oh its my skin getting used to it. Well then still continued using, and another break out. So i finally looked it up, cuz im like ok. Maybe its the bew product i just brought. I finally seen the reviews and im thinking "really" its this oil cleasing, so i stopped using it and only used the the poor deep cleansing foam. Breakouts went away. Idk what it is that in this product thats making me breakout. But sad that i cant use it. The othwr products tho. Work tealky good.
Great cleanser. I do not skip this step, then follow with the foam cleanser

avis.titre: I don't think this is for everyone
avis.texte: This sadly made me break out. I was excited to try an oil cleanser for the first time. But it made me have a ton of little break outs around my nose. I would recommend you try it (because you never know till you try) but beware it can make some skin types break out.

I purchased the Anya sample/travel kit and was blown away by each product. I then purchased this cleansing oil in hopes to find a good makeup remover that was better than my makeup remover sheets I've been using. Honestly.. I feel like it removed eye makeup that I still had on from years ago! I used a little too much… Going forward will use maybe a dime size… It's very concentrated! I have found my new go to make up remover!
I'm on my third bottle of this cleaning oil. I follow it with another Anua cleanser and I love how my skin feels after.
I had a sample from a previous purchased and decided to purchase the bigger size. This cleansing oil is amazing!It hydrate my skin and gives me the natural glow your skin supposed to have.
The cleanser is both exfoliating and gentle. That is a rare combination. It takes off make up beautifully and when you go over it with a toner there's nothing left of your cosmetics on your face.

I have acne prone skin and I started using this oil cleanser as the first step in my routine. My skin has never been softer and it hasn't broken Me out! I follow it up to the youth to the people cleanser and my skin has never felt better.

I've only been using this product for a couple days now, but right off the bat I can say that it works just like the videos show! clears the gunk right out of my skin and has minimized my pores already in such little time!
Pain to return but this stuff is deadly. My eyes still itch and burn ten hours later. Never had a problem like this with anything. Would not go near this brand if it were free.
I saw a lot of people raving abut this & so I decided to get it but it broke me out a lot & I had a pretty clear face before I used it
My favorite oil cleanser! It leaves skin feeling more hydrated than every other similar product I've tried. Gently removes makeup, sunscreen, oil, etc
Honestly my favorite oil cleanser. Can feel it unclogging my pores while I use it and leaves my skin soft. Doesn't break me out!
This clogged my pores so badly it took me a year to get my skin back to normal.

This product clogged the ever loving sheeps out of my face, it emulsifies and it feels thin but i got bumps all over my face completely it was horrible then came whiteheads and they all went away once i stopped using this cleansing oil, if you dont like this one, I doubt you will like the mild one because both are absolutely terrible and overrated. This product absolutely sucks and should be at the bottom of the barrel.
the positive reviews have to be paid. this is the worst oil cleanser i have ever used. it gave me the worst skin texture i have ever had. look up reddit reviews before buying this, i wish i did!

I'm so surpriaed by the negative reviews. This has not caused any acne for me, and has done quite the opposite. I've had perimenopausal back acne for 4 years and nothing gets rid of it - not even prescription creams - UNTIL THIS! In a little over one week all of those thousands of tiny bumps (and some big pimples) on my back were completely gone and it has been silky smooth for over two months now. Wish i would have tried this product sooner and i just can't believe I suffered for years when i courl have been usng this cleanser. I use it on my face too and my skin looks amazing and fresh. Highly recommend!

Im korean and i literally NEVER break out but this made me break out so much. I tried to keep using it for 2-3 months since your face breaks out with new products but i couldnt keep using it…. So disappointing because it smells good and melts into your face
Hate it hate it hate it, gave me acne that im still trying to get rid of months later

Great product for blackheads! I have oily skin and have noticed fewer breakouts and less visible pores since using it. It also doesn't dry out your skin. I definitely feel like I was missing out before trying this!

i am 99% sure all the positive reviews are paid for. this is the worst skin care product i have ever used, and caused a specific type of acne all of my chin that i an still trying to get rid of 2 months later. i had to go to the dermatologist to get it fixed. i have seen hundreds of comments on other social media platforms talking about fhe same experience. if you have ever had a single pimple in your life, do not use this. it also doesnt even wash makeup off that good, if nothing else wont make you buy it.

I used to have a pretty oily face. After buying this, within a week it has completely changed my skin. Skin looks clearer, pores use to release soo muchh sebum and it was annoying. My face looks like what it's supposed to now. Amazing product
I dont know if i'm sensitive to an ingredient or if this product is way too harsh. Burned my skin and left me with hundreds of tiny itchy red bumps all over my face.

I personally love this oil cleanser! I was sure to PATCH TEST (I dont think alot of people in the reviews are patch testing this product, which you should absolutely do everytime you introduce a new product to your skin) and it turns out it works really well for my skin! It shrinks your pores and takes off makeup/suncreen very well!

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again.
avis.texte: After using this cleansing oil I started getting little pimples on my forehead and cheeks. At first I thought it left my skin soft and moisturized but it's leaving my skin feeling suffocated, I don't believe it's actually cleansing the face. I prefer la roasche pose.

avis.titre: This is a good cleansing oil
avis.texte: This is my first time trying out the Pore Control Cleansing Oil (my esthetician recommended me) and it actually pretty good, it cleans out super well enough to clean out all the pores and acne in your face, I notice a huge difference, I have less acne and pores have gotten smaller, along with the deep Pore Deep Cleansing Foam with double cleanse even better, I highly recommend trying out the Korean skincare line.

This is a really good cleansing oil, it cleans away dirtiness and cleans out pores, follow up with the Pore Deep Cleansing Foam you will notice a huge difference in your skin. I highly recommend the cleansing oil.
i have generally had pretty good skin my whole life but this product made me break our like i never have before. its a shame because i love the texture but obviously it just didn't work for my skin

I really wanted to love this, but my skin did not. Unfortunately, I broke out in multiple spots after using twice. I'd say I have mildly sensitive skin and semi acne-prone skin. This product feels nice on the skin and leaves a soft feel on the skin after rinsing. Has a pleasant smell. If your skin is reactive in any way, I'd maybe skip this one.
Returned. Burned my daughter's skin. Had to repair skin barrier.
This caused me to break out massvely in a way i havent in years. I doubled cleansed with it and my whole face is covered in welts and closed comedones.

I use this as a the first step in a duo cleanse with Anua and it is absolutely amazing. This oil smells nice, feels nice on your skin, and it helps the part 2 really foam up and feel great. It also cleans off makeup really well.

avis.titre: First K-Beauty Product...Won't Be the Last
avis.texte: Anua's Heartleaf Pore Control Cleansing Oil is a staple of my routine. It easily removes makeup and excess sebum and after a long day, and it cleans deeply but gently. Nice smell too, very fresh and pleasant. So glad I tried it, and I hope to try more Anua products in the future.

It is the best oil cleanser for this prize range. Not really giving big wow effect but doing what it promises and considering the price a very good product. I have mixed, sensitive, acne prone skin and was skeptical when I red the reviews. However for my skin it works perfectly and cleans makeup easily, especially for removing eye makeup it is very effective. My skin feels smooth and moisturized after the wash and unlike many other oil cleansers it doesn't left a film on the skin and eyes. For my big pores I need specific product to keep them tight but bonus is that this product does not make them worse.

I never leave reviews this oil cleanser is worth a review! My skin texture has never been better after using this as my 1st cleanse. Removes all of my make up and sunscreen. My face never feels dry after using this. Highly recommend. I will be repurchasing!

i read the reviews and it was a mix of good and bad so i decided to try it out, i was consistent with it for about almost a month because i have sebaceous filaments on my nose and it just made them worse (i used the green cleanser too)
I love this cleanser and its terture on the skin feels really good, It removes the waterproof makeup really well

I used this product for two days and it completely ruined my skin. Seems like everyone that reacts to this product breaks out in the sane area and its a bunch if painful tiny white bumps that ended up leaving me with scars.

Okay not gonna lie i had terrible black heads on my nose and I've used this for five months now im almost done with it and I will say the results are good. Prior to this i had issues with my make up separating on my nose and since i start cleansing with this I haven't seen any separation and my black heads are minimal.

avis.titre: Holy grail oil cleanser for stubborn blackheads
avis.texte: I have huge pores on my nose with blackheads that never went away. I've tried many different products like biore, bha, blackheads scrubs and nothing worked for me. After I use this oil cleanser, my pores became smaller and no more clogged blackheads! My skin feels so soft and clear. People compliemnt my skin everyday!! For those who says its not cleansing well or breaking out, they might not be correctly using it. Gently massage the oil into your pores. Then add a small amount of water to emulsify it, continuing to massage so the oil melts away impurities and thoroughly cleanses the skin. Your skin will be very clean afterwards!!! Love this product!!

avis.titre: I would soooo buy this product again!!!
avis.texte: Nothing has ever worked this good on my pores! It's really gentle on the skin too!
I love the cleansing oil and a little goes a long way so this bottle will last minute a while!!
Clogged your pores, made me break out! I wanted to try something new and it was my worst nightmare. Not using this again!

avis.titre: its good, but not the best...
avis.texte: like I really like it, its not irritating and it doesnt have a fragrance. but as far as like cleaning power, its mid. like it leaves this like oily residue along with the makeup you already took off. you will absolutely have to double cleanse with this. I like it, but I will probably purchase something different.

The smell is too strong. I feel like the smell never fully goes away. Even if I wash my face two times with a cleanser. It also doesnt really remove makeup. Mascara will always be there. I feel like there are better cleansing oil options.

avis.titre: I would buy it again but wish it came in a different bottle
avis.texte: So far I love this cleansing oil. My face feels extremely clean after without feeling dried out or oily. It removes very easily with water. My only critique is the pump, it shoots out easily without control so I have to hold my hand a certain way.

Such a good pre cleanse oil! I have super dry sensitive acne prone skin that is very clog prone, and this oil doesn't set off any of those issues. Anua is an amazing brand in general, and I'm glad I started using more of their stuff. I see a huge difference in my skin!

I got the smaller bottle of this and its great!!! I used it up in about two months and so far it's made my pores look so much better. The only thing is that I feel like I dont see a huge difference other than the pores on my nose and it makes my makeup application so much smoother but that's the whole point of it ig lmao. My makeup on my nose used to look so cakey cause my pores were so clogged and this helped SO much. It also removes my makeup so well. definitely recommend trying this product.
So far I think this is working great and my daughter loves it too

I like this cleansing oil except for the smell. It has a medicinal smell and I find it lingers on my face, which I haven't experienced with other cleansers before. I am going to go back to my previous oil cleanser after this is used up. I don't notice much difference with my pores.

This product is surprisingly now one of my favorite skin care products. Rubbing it into my face, my pores look smaller and tighter after a month (probably just deeply cleaned out). I bought this to remove makeup; its just ok at that, I have to go in with micellar water after this for regular mascara. So that explains 3 star reviews IMO: it's just ok at makeup removal. It is FANTASTIC at deeply cleansing pores.

avis.titre: Love!!! But not on its own.
avis.texte: I love the Anua oil cleanser, just re-purchased my second bottle. I do not use this alone. It goes great with the Anua facial cleanser (green bottle). I use this alongside a secondary cleanser to take off days when i only where a cc cream or a full beat face with foundation and concealer.

I honestly had no problem with this cleansing oil despite its ratings and reviews. I think it does its job, it cleaned my face well and when I really want to get the pimples out of my face, it helps loosen them. I had no breakouts from this and I felt like when I didnt use this then it would lead to a break out, I will definitely repurchase!
I have tried multiple make up removers and this is by far the BEST one on the market!!!! I am such a picky person with sensitive skin and this is a miracle product! Highly recommend
I love this stuff and it has made a huge difference in my skin. This leaves my face so clean and soft. Will buy again and again.
I am on my third bottle of this cleansing oil and when it is gone I will purchase more!

Completely burned my skin, to the point of scabbing for over a month. This was after just one use. I ended up at the Urgent Care and then Dermatologist and was in actual pain. I called my daughter in tears several times. Avoid. Actually … RUN away from this paid viral advertising nonsense.

avis.titre: Not for MY skin but it could be for YOU!
avis.texte: I have oily/acne prone skin. An hour after using this product for the first time, my skin started itching and a bump appeared on my face so I didn't use it again. However, my mom (dry facial skin) uses it & it does her skin very well. She loves it!

First use i knew this was next level good. I have tried many make up removing skin cleaning oils. They usually make my skin feel super gross very greasy- or painfully dry. If I use them in my eye area, it actually gets like an oil film over my eye that makes it a little hard to see and or burns my eyes. This doesnt do any of that!! This removed all face products woth 1 application and about 90% of my eye makeup. I wear very heavy eye makeup so the mascara is hard to remove. This washes off with water on a face towel. My skin feels completely fine and normal afterwards, which is super uncommon for me. I loved it. I ordered another bottle immediately. But then I let her reviews and I kept seeing people saying it's causing cystic acne so I held off on a review to make sure that withh daily use this didnt cause any issues. I have sensitive, extreme acne prone skin, and this has worked beautfully for me. No acne or skin irritation at all. 10/10 i recomend.
A lot of people don't read the instructions before using but if you use this product like it says how to on the back, it will clear your skin!
This works great for me. People seem not to like it but ive never had a problem with it. I have dry, eczema prone, sensitice skin. It has shrunken my pores for sure!! No breakouts.

Caused my whole face to breakout massively when i returned this the girl asked what was wrong with it she then looked up at my whole face that had been slightly sunburnt plus the wash and she didnt have to ask any more questions
oilier than most cleansing oils. usually with water it is mostly removed, though this needs 1-2 washes with regular cleanser to be removed.

avis.titre: Got acne for the first time in my life with this product.
avis.texte: This product feels nice on the skin and it removes all makeup and residue, however I'm not one to break out and this gave me the worst acne of my life at 37 years old. Steer clear of this product unless you want to look horrible for 6 weeks.
Definitely will not buy again. After 5 days of using it I started breaking out. Which I stopped using it immediately. 3 days later my face started clearing out 🙌🏻

I'm sure that this may work for some people, so take this with a grain of salt as everyone is different and I've heard good things about this cleanser. I'm just gonna share my experience as someone with combination, acne prone skin. I was already breaking out a bit, so I decided to give this cleanser a shot to see if it would help my skin. I used it for 3 days and it seemed like it was going ok. However, not long after I started using it, I started to break out with little white heads all over my face. It wasn't a huge deal, I figured my skin was just adjusting to it. Then came the cystic acne. It has now been two weeks since I've stopped using the cleanser and I'm still having the worst cystic acne that I've had since I was like 17. It will not stop. Everyday I wake up with at least 3 new pimples and one new cyst somewhere on my face. It's so bad that for the first time in my life, I have to see a dermatologist and possibly get on medication due to the amount of cysts that came out of nowhere after I started using this oil cleanser. It's painful, it's deep, and nothing will help. I think oil cleansers work for some skin types, but if you are like me and have acne prone combination skin, you will probably regret using this.

Now that i see reviews about this product i know it was mot just me,i used it for about a month when i starred deceloping like acne (i never had prior) like white heads on my cheeks it was weird ,I stopped using it and after a few weeks it cleared so i know it was this product ,I wanted to like this so much but its no good ,stay away from this product.
This rly moisturizes and gets the dead skin off and help with large pores. It smells good and feels good

Used this product for maybe 3 weeks and it gave me the worst cystic acne of my life (im 26 y/o) everywhere on my face. So painful and gross with all the whiteheads. Have not had bad acne since high school. I think i had to use a whole sheet of pimple patches a week. My skin has finally recovered after 3 months since use but now have all this scarring i have to deal with...
i love this product for removing my make up. It doesn't make me break out at all. Love it so much.

This was one of the most damaging products I've ever used on my skin. Within two days of using it as part of a double cleansing routine, I began breaking out badly. I stopped using it immediately, but the damage was already done. I developed a painful cystic breakout, including a large cyst/boil on my chin (larger than a quarter) that's been leaking clear fluid for days despite treatment. I've also had a lingering pimple on my temple and several scabbed areas where other pimples formed. I've been using antibiotic ointment and may need to seek medical attention at this point. After reading more reviews, I noticed others experienced similar breakouts from this product. I wish I had seen those sooner. Please use extreme caution if you decide to try it. This has been a truly painful and upsetting experience.

I debated the brand but now I can't imagine not using cleansing oil followed by the pore deep cleansing foam. It's a great duo! I have sensitive skin, tends to be on dry side, and I have some redness. These products have not irritated me or caused breakouts.
Helped calm the redness around my nose. This is step 1 for my double cleanse.

I went through two bottles of this cleansing oil and I was breaking out so bad. I was convinced it wasn't this product. Meanwhile, two months later I really had bad acne. I happen to run out and used my old cleansing oil and within a week my skin was clearing up!

i bought the mini bottle to try and this product makes my face so smooth and soft! it takes off all my makeup very easily and is very gentle on the skin. i love pairing this with the anua cleansing foam as it smoothens and hydrates my skin well, i will definitely be buying the big bottle next time!

If you massage the areas that are prickly (white heads) (i usually do my chin, nose, side of nose, basically T-zone) i do it for about 1min or so & it becomes super smooth! Although it isn't permanent results but it does do the job! haven't really seen any breakouts on myself but this is a pretty good prickly whitehead smoother.

avis.titre: I love how it cleans my face making it look healthy
avis.texte: I been using this product for about 4 weeks and I definitely love it. It makes my skin clean, soft and healthy.

avis.titre: Wanted to love it so bad
avis.texte: I was so ready for some good skincare. But iver the first week my skin broke out wayyyy worse than it has. Probably since I was a teenager.
I love this oil cleanser. It's a dry oil and it's so great at cleansing that on super long days I almost forget to wash my face with the foaming cleanser after because my face feels so clean.
It made my face nice and soft, but didn't remove any blackhead or whitehead, I would say no

avis.titre: Non-Acne Prone Skin, Now Have Lots of Whiteheads
avis.texte: 2 months ago I purchased Anua Cleansing Oil and I went from never having a pimple ever, to having around 8 whiteheads that keep reoccurring. I stopped using last week and skin is clearing up. Reddit says this is a common Anua problem :(
I'm still figuring if this one is is right for my skin but love how it makes my skin feel.

avis.titre: I would buy this product over and over again
avis.texte: I really think this is a great oil cleanser. I've never used before, and I've only been using for about week. My skin is soft and smooth and the pores look smaller; and overall, my skin looks less congested, brighter. It's a great price too. So worth it.

I ordered this full size because I fell in love with the travel size, which I received as fgwp, the thing is that I used the travel size just once a week (on the weekends when I wear makeup) and I loved how it removed my makeup (even waterproof mascara), ok! So I ordered the full she and started using it daily to remove my sunscreen and yes I double cleanse and I did wet my hands and emulsified before rinsing and going with my water base regular face wash, it's been let's say almost 2 weeks and I started noticing some texture in my forehead buuuuut suddenly I woke up with this TERRIBLE reaction, acne type of breakouts in my whole face, some hurt, some itch, some look swollen. I'm now trying to recover my skin, with minimal tried skin care (just face wash, sunscreen am and face wash light lotion pm), I'm scared because this is the first time this happens to me, I used to have severe acne in my teenager years, now I'm 42 and having this experience makes me think that I need to be more careful when using new products. Wonderful product but NOT FOR MY SKIN 🥲

It clogs pores and caused me to break out badly. Also its really hard to wash off even following the instructions on the bottle it always felt like I had oil residue no matter how much I washed it off.

10/10-Absolutely love this product! I use waterproof mascara and this stuff melts it off!! I hated using the waterproof makeup removers it would make my eyes blurry for a few minutes after using. My face feels so much cleaner using the double cleanse method.
Im not lying when i say… this is the best skincare product I have ever used in my life. In ONE use my pores were completely undetectable. Needless to say, ill be buying this forever.

be careful if you have oily skin or are acne prone. ive had my oily skin under control for years and decided to branch out. yes, I emulsified the oil. sadly, it still broke me out. I havent had a breakout this had in i can't tell you how long. my whole face. its been over a week of trying to fix this... awful.
This stuff is AMAZING! Melts makeup off without leaving face greasy. And leaves skin soft and glowing!

I have sensitive dry skin and i dont wear makeup. I have a lot of congestion and wanted to add in something that wouldnt be irritating for my skin. Honestly my skin started looking so much better just after a few days of adding in this product. It doesnt dry my skin and is not harsh. The product does have a smell to it but i dont mind it. I use this almost everyday and have no issues with sensitivity or dryness. I have had noticably less breakouts after starting to use this. I would definitely repurchase it.

I havent had breakouts like this since HIGHSCHOOL. This product is comedogenic and will break you out terribly if you have oily prone skin at all. I NEVER get breakouts on my forehead and am now riddled with acne. Do yourself a favor and skip this one out, or else you will be having to slowly repair the damage this cleansing oil causes.

Purchased the travel size to try out since its been going viral on thr internet but to me it was ok i didnt see much of a difference. I probably wouldnt re purchase again. I did like it however to help remove my left over makeup after wiping it off with makeup remover.

My friend bought me this for christmas and ive been obsessed since. I put it on before I get in the shower and rinse it off once im in it. Works perfectly to melt ALL makeup off and leaves my skin feeling so supple. If you havent tried this before, id recommend giving it a shot
I have've only used it once but I love it already! I will repurchase for sure.
I used the oillast night abd the face wash and today my skin stings and is itchy. Woke up with swollen eyes. Not using again. Glad I bout the trial size only- wish i could return.

All I can say is ouch!!! My skin has never been so dry in my life! I used this for 3 nights when I started to notice burning in my eyes when I was removing my make up..it didnt stop there when I put on all the products I love and have used with no prior reaction start to literally burn my whole face..I have oily acne prone skin, and thought I could benefit from double cleansing but this product was way to harsh for me.

avis.titre: Causes Clogged Pores and Cystic Acne
avis.texte: While it did cleanse the skin and took my makeup off, it clogged my pores so bad to the point of giving me cystic acne (which I don't normally get). It took me a minute to realize it was this product that was the culprit. It seems that others have the same issue too and could potentially be caused by the ingredient Ethylhexyl Palmitate.

I only recenrly started using oil cleansers - this was my first and last try. I love this stuff. Affordable, and makes my dry and sensitive skin feel so clean and hydrated! I use this first and a foam cleanser after and its a great combo

avis.titre: DO NOT GET if u have any type of acne prone skin
avis.texte: I used it stupidly without realizing that it was actually breaking me out for 2 months but then i realized that oil cleasing and especially this oil cleanser was breaking me out horribly. I switched to micellar water. Please do not get this cleanser if u are acne prone or sensitive.
